description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called GatewayDiscoveryDebugLogView, which displays discovery debug logs for a gateway connection, including timestamps, messages, and a copy button to export logs.

methods.name: formattedLog
methods.description: Creates a string representation of the discovery debug log entries, formatting each timestamp in ISO8601 format and concatenating entries with newlines.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a 'HH:mm:ss' string.

methods.name: formatISO
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO8601 string with fractional seconds.
